page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64 and features 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, along with support for AES, SHA-NI, and standard AVX instructions, though it lacks AVX-512 and AMX extensions. System memory is configured at 16.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware configurations exclude local storage and GPU accelerators entirely, relying on external network storage for disk operations. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Benchmark profiles indicate strong single-core compute performance, placing in the top 25 percent on stress-ng, accompanied by average Geekbench single-core throughput and standard gzip compression speeds. Conversely, parallelized workloads show limitations, reflected by bottom-quartile ratings in multi-core stress-ng, PassMark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

Data throughput metrics reveal an average large-block uncached read bandwidth of 40.66 GB/sec and a lower write bandwidth of 19.68 GB/sec. Redis SET operations hit 4.1 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput reached 4.92 GB/sec. In lightweight artificial intelligence tasks, the instance delivers moderate text generation speed on smaller 135M parameter models at 149.29 tokens per second, but drops to 6.45 tokens per second on 7B models.

Given its balanced resource profile and dedicated compute allocation, the ecs.g7a.xlarge offers practical resource density for mid-tier application hosting. It is best suited for general web serving, light database tasks, staging environments, API gateways, and enterprise business applications that rely on consistent per-core execution rather than heavy vectorized parallel processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of memory on an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it provides 32 MB of L3 cache along with AES and standard AVX instructions, omitting AVX-512 and hardware accelerators. The instance includes no local storage and provisions a baseline network speed of 2 Gbps. In benchmark tests, the instance demonstrates strong single-core CPU throughput, while multi-threaded compute, memory write bandwidth, and static web serving register in lower performance tiers. With a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation, ecs.g7a.xlarge delivers predictable baseline capacity for common cloud workloads such as enterprise web servers, microservices, light relational databases, and background application processes.
